summary: Static technical audit against expanded file (scripts/expand-md.js confirmed byte-identical to source -- no {{prompt:}} markers present) + four compendiums (platform_and_boundaries, research_claims, prompts, pedagogy technical subset). This is a pure slide-format theory-consolidation closer with zero fenced prompts and zero platform-capability assertions in student-facing body; nearly all check_platform_and_boundaries.md and check_prompts.md rules are structurally N/A for this artifact type. The genuinely checkable claims cluster in the maintainer block: (1) two academic citations (Paul David 1990, Brynjolfsson/Rock/Syverson 2021) both independently re-verified live 2026-07-10 (curl, 200 OK), correctly labeled [academic/research], correctly framed as historical-context-not-current-evidence, freshness-stamped per the source-freshness-format.md grammar with correct due-date math (checked+6mo); (2) the SVG-derivation claim that the-whole-map (M2) and the-map-filled-in (M6) both render on one page (motivating the wm- to mf- id re-prefix) verified true via scripts/build-workbook.js's THEORY_HANDBOOK_MANIFEST; (3) the placement/wiring claim (penultimate M6 beat, between the-loop-has-a-name and agents-that-build-agents) verified true against spot-gaps-build-the-loop.md, trainer-guide.md, and trainer-modules.md, all consistent; (4) the governor-promotion claim (M4 carry-in question reused verbatim) verified true against the-far-half.md line 112; (5) all three canonical design docs cited (theory-plan.md, theory-evals.md, theory-audit.md) exist at repo root. Two non-blocking findings: the maintainer block's Donald Campbell BVSR attribution and its Wikimedia Commons/Wikipedia control-loop-diagram source both name a real, findable source (independently verified alive) but lack the clickable URL + bracket label that the same maintainer block's other two citations carry -- an internal formatting inconsistency, not a misrepresentation (both are already framed honestly as design-side/historical, not current evidence, and neither claim reaches the student body). No blocking findings.
